5.7.5 Environmental Data Condition to SOVD Content Element
Similar to the obtainment of values from a DiagnosticDataElement, as described in
[3] Chapter 4.3.7.2.1, it is possible to refer to a DiagnosticSovdContentElement
to evaluate an environmental condition.

Semantics of DiagnosticEnvSovdDataCondition ⌈The
meta-class DiagnosticEnvSovdDataCondition represents an atomic condition
that compares the current value of the referenced DiagnosticSovdContentEle-
ment with a constant value defined by the ValueSpecification aggregated in the
role compareValue.⌋

Note
